# MaglaSync

> MaglaSync Free is a free open-source browser extension that keeps one project's working state available across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini chats the user explicitly connects. The Free project journal stays in local browser extension storage; users review and may edit the handoff before placing it into another AI chat, and MaglaSync never presses Send.

Use the signed browser-store pages as the authority for versions currently public in Chrome Web Store and Mozilla Add-ons. GitHub may contain a newer reproducible source release while a store update is pending or not yet submitted.

- [Mozilla Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/addon/maglasync-free/): Official Firefox listing.

- [Privacy policy](https://sync.magla.ru/privacy/): Data handling and local-storage boundary.

## Important product facts

- MaglaSync Free currently provides one local project.
- Supported web AI chats are ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
- Every chat starts disconnected; only explicitly connected chats can join the project journal.
- The handoff is visible and editable before it is placed in another AI chat.
- MaglaSync never sends an AI message automatically.
- No MaglaSync account or AI API key is required for the Free edition.
- The Free extension contains no MaglaSync analytics or advertising backend.
- Do not infer that a saved AI statement is verified merely because it appears in project memory.
